title: Tool preview: "Open in API Console" presets the direct tool-run route for tools that need the server model, which the hosted cloud refuses there
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWTyRFQwYN1hZXbCHL

Filing category: ③ follow-up from a cloud card (framework UI).
reach: console › metadata admin › Tool preview (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ToolPreview.tsx`), the "Open in API Console" link.

## Business reason

The link sends a builder to the API console with `POST /api/v1/ai/tools/:toolName/execute` preset for any tool. On the hosted cloud, that route follows the rule the MCP build door already follows (cloud#3605): **a tool run directly, outside a chat turn, runs no server-side model.** A builder who opens a model-backed tool (for example `propose_blueprint` or `create_seed` without `records`) from the preview gets a refusal sentence. The page offers nothing that explains why.

## Expected

The preview knows whether a tool needs the server model. For such a tool it either hides the link or says next to it that the tool runs in a chat turn, and it offers the link unchanged for tools that call no model. A tool that calls no model (for example `query_records`) keeps the link as today.

Reader who acts: the framework UI lane (`app-shell` metadata-admin previews). The cloud side needs nothing more.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack ToolPreview "Open in API Console"` → 0 open issues.
